corrections.description: Author doubts attachment mechanism; categorical synopsis must not erase uncertainty.
Body hypothesizes pressure causing tissue absorption, not base being absorbed by bone as summary suggests.
Metadata outgoing direction does not assign council-minute text to Darwin; body unavailable.
Length criticism is tentative shortening of geological introduction only, not blanket paper-too-long judgment.

summary: Sixteen targets: fourteen Darwin authorial witnesses, two missing letters represented by institutional minutes. Root full sources and extra1650 read, seven prior contexts reused with matching accepted evidence including actual earlier diagram.
